units.source_text: 驹子就像被吸引住似地猛扑了上来，

en.t: Komako lunged forward as though she had been drawn in,

units.source_text: 岛村觉得仿佛有一种温暖的东西轻轻地贴近过来，

en.t: Shimamura felt as if something warm were softly pressing close to him,

units.source_text: 因而他对驹子的这种举动并没有感到不自然或者危险。

en.t: and so he felt nothing unnatural or dangerous in what Komako was doing.

units.source_text: 驹子像要抱住车窗，举起了一只胳膊。

en.t: Komako raised one arm as if to embrace the train window.

units.source_text: 袖口滑落下来，露出了长衬衣的颜色。

en.t: Her sleeve slipped down, revealing the color of her underrobe.

units.source_text: 那色彩透过厚厚的窗玻璃，沁入岛村冻僵了的眼睑。

en.t: That color passed through the thick window glass and soaked into Shimamura's frozen eyelids.
